name: single-failure-approval

finding.title: A failed blocker lookup approves a pull request with open blockers
finding.description: `blocking` starts as `false`, and when `listOpenBlockers` fails, such as on a rate limit or a server error, the catch only logs. `approveIfClear` then approves the pull request although blocking threads are open, so one failed API call lets an unreviewed change through.
finding.suggestedFix: Return without approving when the lookup fails, so a failure keeps the pull request held.
